bio: What this restaurant lacks in variety, it makes up for it in quality. Since 2005, the establishment has been serving up hearty bowls of ox bone soup, the ultimate Korean comfort food. The recipe, handed down to the current proprietor by his mother-in-law, has been tweaked over the years, but one thing remains constant — the love and care put into each and every bowl of soup. It is highly-recommended for those seeking a truly local experience....
